name: friction-review
description: Use this skill to turn recurring friction patterns from friction summary into specific, minimal, human-reviewed amendments to src/rules/ or src/skills/. Uses friction resolve after an accepted amendment, proposes a diff per pattern, and never auto-applies.
when: When reviewing recurring friction summary entries to propose rule/skill amendments
do-not-use-when: Logging a single friction entry — use friction add
The friction summary is empty or has no recurring patterns
Reviewing a code diff or PR — use code-review instead
